Key points:\n\n- **Architecture**: RV32I/E, M (mul/div), C (compressed), B (bit manipulation) extensions\n- **Origins**: Originally \"Zero-riscy\" from PULP platform, now maintained by lowRISC\n- **Supported configurations** (with performance/area):\n  - `micro`: RV32EC, 0.904 CoreMark/MHz, 16.85 kGE (Yosys)\n  - `small`: RV32IMC, 3-cycle mult, 2.47 CoreMark/MHz, 26.60 kGE\n  - `maxperf`: RV32IMC, 1-cycle mult, branch target ALU, writeback stage, 3.13 CoreMark/MHz, 32.48 kGE\n  - `maxperf-pmp-bmfull`: RV32IMCB, 16 PMP regions, 66.02 kGE\n- **Simple System**: A basic integration example targeting simulation (Verilator)\n- **Ibex Demo System**: A more complete system with debug module for Arty A7 FPGA (separate repo)\n- **License**: Apache 2.0\n\n---\n\n### 3. ibex_configs.yaml (Full Content)\n\nThis file defines **named configurations** that set all module parameters.
